scope: Eight common starter-kit sensor modules, external wiring header contacts only; no existing entries or geometry modified.

verification.moduleImport: Eight entries validated by defineFamily; both SVG modes generate without non-finite values.
verification.visual: All 16 labeled and unlabeled views reviewed in headless Chrome. Physical header order compared with the linked manufacturer photographs and wiring diagrams.
verification.nativeKiCad: All eight symbols and eight footprints loaded and plotted successfully with native kicad-cli. Native GUI was not available.
verification.focusedTests: 11 catalog and catalog-tool checks passed; pin-to-pad mappings, terminal numbers, both SVG modes and native export generation validated.

limitations: PCB revisions are not marked in the cited manufacturer module photos; exact shown SKUs/variants are selected.
All native footprints are explicitly reference carriers: approximate envelopes/header origin; selected 1.0 mm drill and 1.8 mm copper are not manufacturer land patterns.
Generated WRL 3D models are approximate; no manufacturer STEP import is claimed.
Header pad numbers retain printed terminal names because the source boards do not print numerical connector contact numbers.
Fitted sensor legs, comparator pins and unused alternative sensor-placement holes are not external wiring-header contacts.
Conductive water/rain outputs depend on the wetting and liquid; no calibrated depth, humidity or rainfall units are claimed.

entries.name: Keyestudio KS0036 Flame Sensor
entries.view: Component side; header at bottom; photo rotations preserve same-side contact order
entries.contactEvidence: Official four-contact wiring diagram, photodetector up: VCC,GND,D0,A0 left-to-right. Tutorial uses D0 and leaves A0 unconnected; Digital prose describes that example, not the full physical contact count.
entries.footprintNote: Reference carrier for Keyestudio KS0036 Flame Sensor; approximate board envelope and header origin, 2.54 mm reference contact pitch, 1.0 mm selected drill and 1.8 mm selected copper. This is not a manufacturer land pattern. Pad identifiers match the printed terminal names and component-side order. Mounting holes, sensor leads and unused component-placement pads are not carrier contacts. Verify the exact supplied module before fabrication. Generated 3D body is approximate.
